content_sections.heading: Indian Oil Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: IOCL has announced recruitment for multiple posts under different disciplines. The post-wise details are given below:

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for Indian Oil Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Candidates having the required educational qualifications can apply for different posts. The eligibility details are as follows: Engineers/Officers: Candidates with Engineering Degree in relevant disciplines or MBA qualification. Law Officers: Candidates with Law Degree (LLB) and required post qualification experience. Assistant Quality Control Officers: Candidates with M.Sc. Chemistry and relevant experience. Junior Engineers/Junior Officers: Candidates with Diploma Engineering qualification in relevant disciplines.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Indian Oil Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official IOCL website. Go to the Recruitment/Career section. Read the official notification carefully. Click on the online application link. Complete registration using email ID and mobile number. Fill out the application form with correct details. Upload required documents and photograph. Submit the application form. Take a printout of the submitted application for future reference.
